doubts: This page describes several separate short walks from Kerr Bay in St Arnaud, so kind is network; W1 (Bellbird Walk) is main only because it is listed first. No road-end feature is clearly the Bellbird Walk car park 'near the east jetty' or the Brunner Peninsula start 'on Kerr Bay Road, just below the Nelson Lakes Visitor Centre'; F6 (where Kerr Bay Track meets Kerr Bay Road) is the only feature on Kerr Bay Road and could be either, so no start ref is given. The Bellbird Walk is a loop because the pathway returns through a wetland; the start and end are the same car park. Honeydew Walk (W2) and Black Valley Walk (W4) give no end and no shape. The Honeydew Walk is matched to map track T3 'Honeydew Track' by name only. The Loop Track's 'St Arnaud Range/Loop Track' could be map track T7 'Loop Track' or T9 'St. Arnaud Range Track', so no ref. W3 ends at the car park, the Lakehead Track returning to it. The Brunner Peninsula walk (W5) returns by streets (Baxter Street or Cotterell Street and View Road) and is recorded as a loop back to its start; the 1 h 30 min longer walk (W6) is a separate way with its own time, returning to Kerr Bay via Rotoiti Lodge and Ward Street. Where on the peninsula the 'next junction' is, the text does not say. No whole-way distances are given.
